seed: The transform bar, at Next defaults with no flag changed (video-animate.html, 'Animate with the overlay'). A title is typed over a recording and picked: no bar yet. Turning it with the knob brings a small glass bar up under it with X, Y, W, H and the angle, within a frame; swinging it with the flat arc adds Tilt X, Tilt Y, Depth and Pivot, and the swing is photographed mid drag with Tilt Y outlined. A whole sum typed into X lands, an angle typed in lands, +10 on the angle steps it on from there. Reset puts the turn and tilt back and leaves the place alone. Escape takes it down and leaves the title picked; an arrow key brings it back; picking another tool takes it down within a frame.

steps.note: the title picked: its box, handles and turn knob, and no bar. Picking a layer is not a transform

THE FIRST TEST: the knob turned the title and a small glass bar came up 12 points under it: X, Y, W, H, the angle mark with its degrees, and Reset. Nothing about 3D, because nothing about the title is in 3D
the flat arc swung the title 40 degrees on Y: Tilt X, Tilt Y, Depth and Pivot joined the bar, and Tilt Y reads 40. The picture held mid swing shows Tilt Y outlined while the hand moved it
THE SECOND TEST: 1920/2 typed into X put the title's left edge at 960; 12 typed into the angle turned it to 12, and +10 then took it on to 22. The bar is still up under it
THE THIRD TEST: Reset put the turn and the tilt back to nought in one step, so the 3D values left the bar; X still reads 960, because Reset leaves the place alone
Escape took the bar down and nothing else: the title is still picked
THE FOURTH TEST: an arrow key nudged the title one point and brought the bar back; picking the Text tool is another operation, and the bar went with it
